subject: Hosted API architecture walkthrough — scheduling and agenda (SDKs, streaming, tool calls)
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@nimblehealth.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tool calls)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the earlier intro — NimbleHealth is evaluating hosted inference for our triage and summarization pipelines and we'd like a focused technical session that covers: SDK integration patterns, streaming best-practices for short-lived sessions, and how to wire tool/function calling safely.

Two goals for the session:
- Validate integration feasibility for our real-time flows (sub-100ms goal for small requests)
- Understand operational tradeoffs (batching vs latency, KV cache, fallbacks)

Would you and someone from the runtime/integration team be available the week of Nov 8? We can do a 60–75 min deep-dive. Our participants would be Natalie (engineering lead) and me; we may also loop in security depending on the outcome.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tues Nov 9, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Nov 10, 14:00–15:15
- Thurs Nov 11, 09:00–10:15

If those don't work, happy to share alternative times.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Green
Director of Platform Engineering
NimbleHealth
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tool calls)

Hi Alex — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the clear goals; we can cover all of that in a single 75-minute session.

Quick answers up front:
- We can demo SDK examples (Python/Node), cover streaming connections and reconnect semantics, and walk through a safe tool-calling pattern (auth, verification, and fallbacks).
- Karthik will present the runtime patterns (batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs). Ava will handle the SDK and end-to-end demo pieces.

A couple of quick Qs that will help us prepare:
1) Do you have a representative prompt/sequence length distribution we should optimize the demo for (e.g., mostly 64–128 tokens vs 512+)?
2) Will you want a live deploy demo against your staging endpoints, or is a recorded run-through sufficient for this first call?

For scheduling, Nov 9 at 10:00 PST works for our team. I can send a calendar invite for 75 minutes and include a short agenda and a code artifact we can share before the meeting.

Attached: Hosted-API-DeepDive-Agenda.pdf (draft). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/98765

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Alex Green <alex.green@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tool calls)

Kimberly / Alex — tagging in a couple of prep notes on my side.

On Nov 9 I'll take the runtime section and show:
- continuous batching behavior and how it impacts 95th pct latency
- KV cache examples and when prefix caching helps vs hurting unit cost
- model fallback policies and cost-latency routing

Ava — can you confirm you have the short Python streaming snippet (the one that demonstrates incremental tokens + reconnect) in sdk_streaming_snippets.tar.gz? I'll reference that in the deck.

Alex — re your Qs: if your traffic is mostly 64–128 tokens, we'll tune the demo for that; if you expect a long-tail (512+), tell us and we'll add a couple of longer examples. For the first session, a recorded run-through is fine — we can follow up with a live staging test if you want to trial traffic.

I'll also prepare a small latency vs cost chart for the 3 configuration knobs we typically suggest.

-Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@nimblehealth.com>, Natalie Brooks <natalie.brooks@nimblehealth.com>

Subject: Confirmed: Hosted API architecture walkthrough — Nov 9, 10:00–11:15 PST

Alex / Natalie — thanks for confirming. Meeting is set for:

Tue, Nov 9 · 10:00–11:15 AM PST (75 minutes)
Google Meet: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123nimble

Draft agenda (attached):
1) Introductions & goals (5m)
2) SDK patterns + streaming demo (Ava) (20m)
3) Runtime & routing (Karthik) (20m)
4) Tool/function-calling patterns and safety controls (Kimberly) (15m)
5) Q&A + next steps (15m)

Prep requests:
- Alex: if you can share a short sample payload distribution (approx token counts) before EOD Nov 6, we'll tailor the demo.
- Team: we'll upload the demo snippets to the Drive link ahead of the call: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C4D5E/view?usp=sharing

Attachments: Hosted-API-DeepDive-Agenda.pdf, sdk_streaming_snippets.tar.gz
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/98765

Look forward to it. If the security team wants to join, we can add a 10–15 minute slot at the end to cover data handling and audit logs.
